## Step 1: Create the integration

1. Open WSO2 Integrator.
2. Select **Skip for now**.
3. Select **Create New Integration**.
4. Set **Integration Name** to `PromoteAnIntegration`.
5. Set **Project Name** to `promotion`.
6. Select **Create Integration**.
7. Select **PromoteAnIntegration**.

## Step 2: Promote to the next environment

1. <!-- manual: Open your integration from the project home. -->
2. <!-- manual: On the integration overview page, locate the environment card you want to promote from. -->
3. Select **Promote** below that environment card.
4. <!-- manual: If this is the first time you are promoting to the target environment, choose how to handle runtime configurations: -->
5. Select **Next**.
6. <!-- manual: If you selected Choose new configurations, enter the values for the target environment. -->
7. Select **Promote**.
